articles.title: BD Launches AI-Enabled Medication Dispensing System to the European Market
articles.mainIdea: BD Launches AI-Enabled Medication Dispensing System to the European Market
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BD Launches AI-Enabled Medication Dispensing System to the European Market. BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) (NYSE: BDX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced the launch of the BD® Pyxis™ Pro Dispensing Solution and BD® Incada™ Connected Care Platform in Europe. This next-generation medication dispensing system combines advanced automation and AI‑driven insights to modernize medication management, reduce disruptions, and improve efficiency while helping clinicians spend more time on patient care.

articles.title: BDx Secures US$320 Million Loan to Accelerate AI-Ready Data Center Infrastructure in Asia
articles.mainIdea: BDx Secures US$320 Million Loan to Accelerate AI-Ready Data Center Infrastructure in Asia
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BDx Secures US$320 Million Loan to Accelerate AI-Ready Data Center Infrastructure in Asia. BDx Data Centers today announced the successful close of a US$320 million loan facility, marking a major milestone in the company's commitment to building world-class digital infrastructure across Asia. Led by Bank Permata, BCA, and KB Bank, the transaction underscores the strong confidence financial partners have placed in BDx's long-term strategy and its execution capabilities. Related tickers mentioned: BNLI.JK.
